simple.meaning: שָׂרָה (sârâh) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to prevail.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Genesis, Hosea, beginning at Genesis 32:29. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׂרָה (H8280).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׂרָה (sârâh) / H8280 is traced through Genesis 32:29, Hosea 12:4 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H8280. sarah I. שָׂרָה verb persist, exert oneself, persevere (Arabic persist, persevere ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳שׂ ׳אֶתאֿ Hosea 12:4 he persevered with God ; 2 masculine singular עִםאֿ ׳שָׂרִיתָ אֲנָשִׁים וְעִם Gen 32:29 (J). — Hosea 12:5 has Imperfect וַיָּ֫שַׂר in same meaning, as if from a (non-existent) שׂוּר ; < read וַיִּ֫שֶׂר (apocope from וַיִּשְׂרֶה ). — שׂוֺרָה Isa 28:25 see above.

occurrences.englishText: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.”
